newsitem.title: UK: NWE fuel oil weakens as low sulph swaps slide $2.5.
newsitem.headline: NWE fuel oil weakens as low sulph swaps slide $2.5.

text.p: NWE fuel oil weakened on Monday under pressure from poor demand and negative sentiment that flourished in thin business.
Low sulphur swaps were down a hefty $2.50 for May with physical prices following in their wake. Dealers said pressure from prompt cargoes had started the slide.
The cargoes were all reported to be small, making them difficult to shift.
Barge business was very slow. An early high sulphur deal was seen at $82 fob ARA but later trades were at $81 for prompt material and $81.50 for something further out.
High sulphur cargoes were little discussed although a British major was heard offering good quality high sulphur cracked fuel out of northern France.
